mapper.select:
SELECT q.id AS q_id, q.estimate_no AS q_estimate_no, q.version AS q_version, q.is_submitted AS q_is_submitted, q.created_by_user_id AS q_created_by_user_id, q.sales_branch_id AS q_sales_branch_id, q.sales_staff_id AS q_sales_staff_id, q.customer_id AS q_customer_id, q.customer_name AS q_customer_name, q.project_name AS q_project_name, q.total_amount AS q_total_amount, q.discount_amount AS q_discount_amount, q.total_cost AS q_total_cost, q.total_profit AS q_total_profit, q.profit_rate AS q_profit_rate, q.grand_total AS q_grand_total,
q.attached_file_path AS q_attached_file_path,
q.issue_date AS q_issue_date, q.remarks AS q_remarks, q.created_at AS q_created_at, q.updated_at AS q_updated_at,
u.id AS u_id, u.name AS u_name,
b.id AS b_id, b.name AS b_name, b.address AS b_address, b.phone AS b_phone,
s.id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name,
c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name,
i.id AS i_id, i.row_order AS i_row_order, i.row_type AS i_row_type, i.item_code AS i_item_code, i.item_name AS i_item_name, i.manufacturer AS i_manufacturer, i.quantity AS i_quantity, i.cost_price AS i_cost_price, i.unit_price AS i_unit_price
FROM quotations q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.created_by_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN branches b ON q.sales_branch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sales_staffs s ON q.sales_staff_id = s.id LEFT JOIN customers c ON q.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN quotation_items i ON q.id = i.quotation_id
WHERE q.id = #{id} ORDER BY i.row_order ASC

SELECT q.id AS q_id, q.estimate_no AS q_estimate_no, q.issue_date AS q_issue_date, q.customer_name AS q_customer_name, q.project_name AS q_project_name, q.grand_total AS q_grand_total, q.created_at AS q_created_at,
u.name AS u_name, s.name AS s_name FROM quotations q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.created_by_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sales_staffs s ON q.sales_staff_id = s.id WHERE 1=1
AND q.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND q.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%')
AND q.estimate_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{estimateNo}, '%')
ORDER BY q.created_at DESC

SELECT q.id AS q_id, q.estimate_no AS q_estimate_no, q.issue_date AS q_issue_date, q.customer_name AS q_customer_name, q.project_name AS q_project_name, q.grand_total AS q_grand_total, q.created_at AS q_created_at,
u.name AS u_name, s.name AS s_name FROM quotations q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.created_by_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sales_staffs s ON q.sales_staff_id = s.id WHERE q.created_by_user_id = #{createdByUserId} ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
